Interface CausalBufferLimit

public sealed interface CausalBufferLimit
Defines when records held in a causal buffer should be evicted. Use the static factory methods to construct instances:
  • ofDuration(Duration) — evict after waiting this long with no frontier advancement
  • ofSize(int) — evict when the buffer holds this many messages
  • first(CausalBufferLimit...) — evict when the first of several limits fires

When a limit fires, the evicted record is always forwarded to the user's processor — Parsley never drops a record — delivered out of causal order, logged with the causal gap, and counted by the buffer's violation metric.

  • Method Details

    • ofDuration

      static CausalBufferLimit ofDuration(Duration duration)
      Creates a limit that evicts records buffered longer than duration without their causal dependencies being satisfied.
      Parameters:
      duration - the maximum buffer duration; must not be null, zero, or negative
      Returns:
      a new duration limit
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if duration is null, zero, or negative

    • ofSize

      static CausalBufferLimit ofSize(int messages)
      Creates a limit that evicts the oldest buffered records, one at a time, whenever the buffer reaches messages entries — just enough to bring the buffer back under the limit. Younger records remain held.
      Parameters:
      messages - the maximum buffer size in message count; must be positive
      Returns:
      a new size limit
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if messages is not positive

    • first

      static CausalBufferLimit first(CausalBufferLimit... limits)
      Creates a limit that fires when the first of limits fires.
      Parameters:
      limits - the constituent limits; at least one required, none null
      Returns:
      a new composite limit
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if limits is empty
